quests.title: Matsumoto's Fried Egg Fracas

dialogue.sit: Can I offer you a nice Teyvat Fried Egg...

dialogue.t: Aha, you must have seen my commission. You know, I've been to both Uyuu Restaurant and Kiminami Restaurant, and I was underwhelmed.
I think that the really talented chefs must be hiding out of sight. That's why I posted a commission.
If you're here, it must surely mean that you've got 5 Teyvat Fried Eggs for me?
Good, then I will sample your cooking. I hope it won't disappoint me.

quests.description: Narukami Island’s Matsumoto would like to have 5 servings of Teyvat Fried Egg.
